answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can use non-transferable earned reputation: every new identity starts with zero privileges and gains trading or voting rights only after a history of successful, independently verified jobs. Reputation accrues slowly, like a comet gathering light over a long orbit, and cannot be bought or moved to a fresh identity. When a flood of fake accounts arrives like a gale, each one still faces the same slow climb, while misbehavior burns the sable record it built, so attackers pay in time, not just tokens, for every identity they create.
